Build passes. Done. I updated `app/BlogHeader.tsx` to load both fonts with `next/font/google` and keep all the font logic and styling inside the component: - **Playfair Display** (weight 700) → applied to the `

` main heading via the `--font-playfair` CSS variable - **Roboto** (weight 400) → applied to the `

` subtitle via the `--font-roboto` CSS variable The font variables are exposed on the `

` through the `className` from each font loader, then consumed inline on each element. `next build` compiled successfully.
